title: Lesson 20 - Opportunity to Quote to Close: Products, Price Books, Quotes, and Approval
description: Given a set of requirements, construct an end-to-end sales process within Salesforce that supports the business from Lead to Opportunity to Quote to Close.

questions.question: How many quotes can be the synced quote on a single Opportunity at one time?
options: Only one quote can be the synced quote
Unlimited, as long as statuses differ
questions.explanation: An opportunity can have many quotes but only one synced quote, and syncing another quote demotes the previous one.

questions.question: A rep cannot add a product to a custom price book. What is the most likely cause?
options: The custom price book is missing a currency
The product has no active Standard Price Book entry
The product record type is wrong
The opportunity is already Closed Won
questions.explanation: A product must exist with an active Standard Price Book entry before a custom price book entry can be created, so the missing standard entry blocks the add.

questions.question: A rep edits the line items on the synced quote. What happens to the opportunity?
options: Nothing until the next forecast rollup
The quote automatically unsyncs and detaches
The synced quote pushes the change to the opportunity, updating the opportunity products and amount
The opportunity stays frozen once it is Closed Won
questions.explanation: The synced quote is the source of truth, so editing its line items updates the opportunity products and amount on sync rather than waiting on a rollup.
